title: ophrys garganica subsp. passionis
intro: Ophrys garganica subsp. passionis, commonly known as the Passion-Orchid Bee Ophrys, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is known for its unique appearance and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys garganica subsp. passionis include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
